narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the graphical method for solving pairs of linear equations. This visual approach will help you understand the different types of solutions equations can have. We'll learn to distinguish between intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines, and relate these graphical outcomes to consistent, inconsistent, and dependent systems of equations. By the end, you'll be able to solve linear equations by simply plotting their graphs and finding their intersection points. Let's begin our visual journey into linear equations!
